description: Trace-level bar product tr_M(q₀)·tr_M(q₀⁻¹) as a binding object — HONEST NEGATIVE (EXPLORATORY). Validated matrix-M tr_M at arbitrary q (cross-check tr_M(deuteron,q₀)=1.33178 vs catalogue). The q<1 mirror tr_M(q₀⁻¹)≈0.0003 is tiny → the bar product underbinds (deuteron required Δ'≈11245, vs signed-tr_M 3.27, vs #1742 archimedean |·| +3.6%). The q→q⁻¹ bar is not the binding realization at any level.

data.conclusion: trace-level bar product REJECTED as the binding object: tr_M(q₀⁻¹) is tiny (q<1), so it underbinds far worse than signed-tr_M (#2082) or the archimedean |·| (#1742). Confirms #1742's per-block bar negative extends to the trace level. Mirror-trace machinery (tr_M at arbitrary q via native matrix-M) is validated and reusable.
